origin: The Hydra never stops. Cut off one head, another rises. Break one attack, the next has already begun.
story: Hunters who hesitate are slowly overwhelmed. Hunters who embrace the flow become impossible to stop.
quotes: Keep moving. Stillness feeds the beast.
unlockText: Something with too many heads has been counting the seconds between your rounds.
victoryText: Every head falls at once, or none do. Today, all of them fall.
rule: Never fight one exercise — fight the entire round. The Hydra wins when you focus on only one head.
hunterAdvice: Keep moving. Stillness feeds the beast.
